note: TOKEN RETENTION 0.90/0.35, egw5wq's successor with ONE change: the keep probabilities. egw5wq ran 0.70/0.20 for 27 epochs and UNDERFITS -- in-sample 0.5451 against shipped 0.5474 at epoch 20, held-out inside a 0.004 band across epochs 5-25 against a paired s.e. of ~0.010, train PAE down only 6.8% against the GT-crop arm's 16.9%, and ||W-W0||^2 flat at ~0.1%/epoch after epoch 24. The PAE descent was a floor effect: p10 -16%, p90 -5%. So the head converged to a point that beats shipped on NEITHER pool, and the reading is that 0.414 of tokens is too aggressive to build a sharp top-of-ranking, which is the only part selection reads. This raises retention to 0.578 of tokens, which is 0.334 of the original pair work -- 1.95x egw5wq and ~94% of ffj8m4's fixed crop, so expect ~45-50 min/epoch. Memory is unchanged because peak is bounded by --ckpt-token-threshold 855, not by mean tokens. L2-SP IS REMOVED ENTIRELY rather than raised to 1e-3: the failure is underfitting, so more regularisation is the wrong direction, and at egw5wq's weight travel its gradient was ~0.1% of the median task gradient anyway (section 17: 1e-4 and below are effectively off), so dropping it changes almost nothing numerically and leaves TOKEN RETENTION as the only difference from egw5wq. Eval cadence is egw5wq's, unchanged: uncropped valfull every 5 epochs, uncropped 738-interface training pool every 10. ORIGINAL MECHANISM: BIASED TOKEN DROPOUT 0.90/0.35 + PAIR DROPOUT 0.25 + L2-SP 1e-5, fresh 60-epoch arm from the pretrained head. ONE CHANGE FROM ffj8m4, the arm it must beat: the union mask stops being a FIXED crop and becomes a PRIOR on a fresh draw each epoch -- a token inside the union survives with p=0.70, outside with p=0.20, drawn once per structure per epoch. WHY: ffj8m4 trains on one fixed 59.8% of tokens, which is memorisable, and never shows the head the periphery -- which is why o2qczq scored 0.6305 cropped and 0.5387 uncropped, below shipped 0.5474. A varying subset cannot be memorised and periphery tokens appear 20% of the time, so uncropped inference stops being a regime the head has never seen. AND IT IS FASTER: a dropped token loses its ROW AND COLUMN from z rather than being zeroed, so 0.499 of tokens is 0.249 of the original pair work against ffj8m4 0.598/0.357. TWO INVARIANTS: one draw per structure per EPOCH shared by all 50 poses, because the relative loss grades the gaps between them and per-epoch is exactly per-step under cross-seed; and every rank draws the SAME mask, seeded sha256(--seed, epoch, pdb) -- hash() is salted per process and would have given each rank a different draw. THE COST ACCEPTED: ipTM pools over the scored pair and normalises by a d0 from its token count, so a varying subset varies the achievable score while the label stays full-structure, and d0 enters nonlinearly so it does not cancel under mean-centring. ffj8m4 already carries that at a fixed 62% of each scored chain; this varies it ~45-62%. EVAL IS ALWAYS UNCROPPED: valfull every 5 epochs, the 738 winnable training interfaces every 10, both uncropped, because a cropped reading carries forced ground-truth contacts and is never a deployment number.
